propositions: A change with bug trailer and >150 non-test lines requires plan-review attestation; escalation rate is 16.3% on current corpus.
A non-test file touched by >=2 prior bug-fix commits within 7 days should escalate even under 150-line floor; repeat-fix rule catches 12 of 22 labelled fixes at 34.8% escalation.
New module repeat_fix.py with repeat_fix_escalates() predicate and parameters must be callable by name from bugfix_size_gate for monkeypatch-by-string test isolation.
Backtest script must support --repeat-fix and --labels-from-caused-by flags to report per-predicate recall and escalation rates against store-derived labels.
Under-floor repeat-fix verdict must be a new coverage field separate from flagged, preserving the pinned invariant that flagged=size-floor-only.
Test test_under_threshold_diff_never_reads_the_store must be rewritten to narrow its invariant: under-floor diffs with no non-test paths or no repeat-fix hit skip attestation classification.
